title: 第5章 一月之约第6章 天机宝玉
content_zh:
苏墨海脸上露出了冷笑之色，立马发难：“十六岁，才是一级武徒，苏震山教子无方，没有为家族培养合适的继承人，我提议，废掉苏震山家主之位，由家族内部另选合适之人担任家主！”
“不错，的确应该重新考虑家主人选了！”
“自己的儿子竟然只是一级武徒，怎么有资格担任家主之位！”
另外三名长老也是纷纷附和。
他们四人都是苏家长辈，本就对苏震山一个晚辈担任家主十分不满，现在得到机会，自然要趁机打压。
苏震山脸上浮现出怒容。
面对众人发难，苏辰的脸上却突然露出了笑容，很是赞同的点了点头：“不错不错，这个提议很好，选一个有厉害后辈的人担当家主，也是为了家族着想。”
此言一出，不论是四大长老，还是那一众家族高手，都是愣住。
苏辰这是傻了？
怎么突然替长老们说起话来了，这也太坑爹了吧！
苏墨海先是一怔，旋即冷笑起来，道：“既然大家都同意，那就废掉苏震山的家主之位！”
“慢！
谁说我答应废掉我爹的家主之位了？”
苏辰伸手制止。
二长老一张红脸上露出怒容：“苏辰，家族大堂议事，岂容你胡来？”
苏辰笑道：“我只是说让后辈天赋更强的人当家主，没说让废掉我爹吧？敢问，咱们家族长老中，谁的后辈天赋最好？”
苏墨海得意一笑：“自然是我的孙子，苏青云，十七岁，已经是七级武徒。”
苏辰点点头：“既然这样，只要我战胜了苏青云，那我爹当家主，就没有任何异议了吧？”
“自然没有！”
苏墨海脸上露出了一丝讥讽的笑容。

在他看来，苏辰似乎已经彻底沦为废人，是否是一级武徒，都是未知的事情。
想战胜他孙子，那简直是痴人说梦！
苏辰点了点头，看向苏墨海道：“那好，我现在就向苏青云发出挑战，一月之后，我们交手一场，若是我输了，我爹不再担任家主，若是我赢了……你们四个就少在那放屁！”
“嘶！”
苏辰此言一出，大堂中的众人都是倒抽一口冷气。
一月之后，挑战苏青云？
苏辰难道疯了？
他还以为自己是当年的那个天水城天才？
“辰儿！”
苏震山大惊失色。
苏辰与苏青云相差足足六级，就算天赋再高，也无法在一月之内跨越六级！
“爹，相信我！”
苏辰凝视自己父亲。
苏震山先是一怔，旋即，他重重的点了点头：“好，我儿一月之后挑战苏青云，若是我儿输了，我便不再担任家主之位！”
“哈哈哈！”
苏墨海忍不住狂笑起来。
在他看来，苏辰之举，简直是自取其辱。
“那好，一个月后，我便让我孙儿在家族擂台上等你！”
说罢，苏墨海冷笑一声，直接甩袖离去，不给苏辰父子二人反悔的余地。
另外三名长老也是一脸冷笑，起身离去。

在他们看来，家主之位，已经到手了！
片刻之后，整个家族大堂，只剩下了苏辰父子二人。
“辰儿，你当真有把握战胜苏青云？”
content_en:
A sneer appeared on Su Mohai's face, and he immediately revolted: "A sixteen-year-old is only a first-level martial arts disciple. Su Zhenshan has no way to teach his children and has not cultivated a suitable heir for the family. I propose that Su Zhenshan be abolished as the head of the family and another suitable person from within the family be selected as the head of the family!"
"Yes, we should really reconsider the choice of family master!"
"My son is only a first-level martial arts disciple, how can he be qualified to be the head of the family!"
The other three elders also agreed.
The four of them are elders of the Su family. They were already very dissatisfied with a junior Su Zhenshan being the head of the family. Now that they got the opportunity, they naturally took the opportunity to suppress them.
An angry look appeared on Su Zhenshan's face.
In the face of everyone's objections, Su Chen's face suddenly showed a smile, and he nodded in agreement: "Yes, yes, this proposal is very good. It is also for the sake of the family to choose someone with powerful descendants as the head of the family."
As soon as these words came out, both the four elders and the family masters were stunned.
Is Su Chen stupid?
Why are you suddenly speaking up for the elders? This is so cheating!
Su Mohai was startled for a moment, then sneered and said, "Since everyone agrees, let's abolish Su Zhenshan's position as head of the family!"
"Slow down!
Who said I agreed to depose my father as the head of the family? "
Su Chen stretched out his hand to stop him.
The second elder's red face showed an angry look: "Su Chen, how can we allow you to do whatever you want when discussing matters in the family hall?"
Su Chen smiled and said: "I just said that the person with the stronger talent of the younger generation should be the head of the family. I didn't say that I would abolish my father, right? I dare to ask, among the elders of our family, who has the best talent of the younger generation?"
Su Mohai smiled proudly: "Of course it is my grandson, Su Qingyun, who is seventeen years old and is already a seventh-level martial arts disciple."
Su Chen nodded: "In this case, as long as I defeat Su Qingyun, then there will be no objection to my father being the head of the family, right?"
"Of course not!"
A sarcastic smile appeared on Su Mohai's face.
In his opinion, Su Chen seemed to have been completely reduced to a useless person. Whether he was a first-level martial arts disciple or not was unknown.
Wanting to defeat his grandson is simply a fool's errand!
Su Chen nodded, looked at Su Mohai and said: "Okay, I will challenge Su Qingyun now. In one month, we will have a fight. If I lose, my father will no longer be the head of the family. If I win... you four should stop farting there!"
"Hiss!"
As soon as Su Chen said this, everyone in the lobby gasped.
One month later, challenge Su Qingyun?
Is Su Chen crazy?
He still thought he was the Tianshui City genius back then?
"Chen'er!"
Su Zhenshan was shocked.
There is a full six levels difference between Su Chen and Su Qingyun. No matter how talented they are, they cannot cross level six within a month!
"Dad, believe me!"
Su Chen stared at his father.
Su Zhenshan was startled at first, and then he nodded heavily: "Okay, my son will challenge Su Qingyun in one month. If my son loses, I will no longer be the head of the family!"
"Hahaha!"
Su Mohai couldn't help laughing wildly.
In his opinion, Su Chen's actions were simply humiliating himself.
"Well, in one month, I will ask my grandson to wait for you in the family arena!"
After saying that, Su Mohai sneered, threw up his sleeves and left, leaving no room for Su Chen and his son to regret.
The other three elders also sneered, stood up and left.
In their opinion, the position of head of the family has been obtained!
After a while, only Su Chen and his son were left in the entire family hall.
"Chen'er, are you really sure you can defeat Su Qingyun?"
